name: Lorain County, OH
findings: Lorain County has 918 nonprofit organizations. 395 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 315 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lorain County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few health care organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 8 health care organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 18 would.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through health care groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 67 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 67 organizations here; 38% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
